append.detail: ── SUPERSEDED 2026-10-06 by ADR-1709 (LIVE-748). The meter numbers this probe pinned were changed by the owner's five-tier ladder, so it now fails by design. Original probe, kept verbatim: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const note=fs.readFileSync("lib/spaces/reach-catalog-note.ts","utf8");if(!note.includes("export function reachCatalogNote"))fail("reachCatalogNote is gone");if(!note.includes("PLACEHOLDER_METER_LIMITS.space_qr"))fail("reach catalog note does not read the QR meter");if(!note.includes("SPACE_PLAN_LABEL.business"))fail("reach catalog note does not name Business from the plan label");if(/Collective/.test(note))fail("reach-catalog-note still types Collective");const cat=fs.readFileSync("lib/admin/modules/space-modules.ts","utf8");if(!cat.includes("reachCatalogNote()"))fail("space.reach no longer reads reachCatalogNote");if(/unlimited on Collective/.test(cat))fail("space.reach still names a Collective QR rung");if(/500 on Business/.test(cat))fail("space.reach still names the leftover 500 Business rung");const meters=fs.readFileSync("lib/pricing/meter-limits.ts","utf8");if(!/space_qr:\s*\{\s*free:\s*3,\s*business:\s*null\s*\}/.test(meters))fail("space_qr left the 3 / unlimited ladder");console.log("LIVE-440 ok")'
